violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed employee did not was hands before handling raw hamburger meat.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Miracle whip and other food items stored on the floor in bar area.--Food package was damaged; integrity of contents was compromised. Observed ground beef package cut open without being put in a closed container.
Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. Eggs not stored in way to prevent contamination.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Observed several containers in different refrigerators not date marked or labeled with contents.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Ceiling had areas of exposed wood.
Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment was not cleaned properly. Observed grease build up around grill.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Observed prep areas not cleaned.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Storage areas not cleaned as required.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.
Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in a clean, dry manner to protect from contamination. Clean utensils stored with dirty dishes.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors had trash and debris built up. Ceiling in not clean with dirty vents, walls had grease and debris.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not maintained in good repair. Observed ceiling tiles falling down, water stain ceiling tiles. Floors missing tile.

Lighting. — --Lighting did not have protective shielding in areas where there is exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, or unwrapped single-service items. Light in kitchen did not have a protective shield.
General premises. — --Food establishment and all parts of the property in connection with their operation were not kept free from litter.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Meat and other food products was not properly dated.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Table that holds the grill has exposed wood.

Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Food contact surface of clean in place equipment was not cleaned properly. Area around deep fryer, grill had build up of grease, cobwebs, food debris.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. prep tables were not clean.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Hood contained excessive build up of grease.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Floors missing pieces. Ceiling falling down--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Walls, Ceiling, Floors were not clean. Had build up of grease.
